But the user explicitly says June 30th 2023. So we might need to clarify. The system might not care about day-of-week. So we will just use the date "2023-06-30".

Thus we need to call musical_ticket_buy with show "Mamma Mia" and date "2023-06-30". And train_ticket_buy with origin "New York", destination "Chicago", date "2023-06-30".
